column5: Ports LineFieldsInfo defaults and overrides plus a planner-leaf schema/tree renderer over already flattened operator metadata. Real Plan/DataAccesser/ExplainInfo extraction, _0 filtering, non-analyze row caching, optimizer flattening, non-row formats, runtime data, and SQL/session consumption remain open.
Represents all thirteen valid format spellings and validator parsing. Traditional currently normalizes directly to Row and the Go package-level mutable string/slice representation is not preserved.
